## AXEL scene layout (`AXEL/axel_project/scenes`)

**Root:** `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/scenes`

- **Arc folders:** `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/scenes/Arc_1` … `Arc_7` — one folder per story arc (major index matches the first number of `major.minor` in filenames).
- **Other scene groups:** `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/scenes/Main_Menu` (e.g. `0.x`), `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/scenes/Endings` (e.g. `8.x`).
- **Shared FX:** `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/scenes/fx` (sub-scenes/shaders such as `NoirPaletteOverlay.tscn`, `noir_palette_filter.gdshader`, `highlighted_locker_palette_filter.gdshader`).
- **Reserved stubs:** `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/scenes/core/.gitkeep`, `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/scenes/ui/.gitkeep` (no `.tscn` there in the tree scan).

### Canonical naming (project tooling)

Authoritative rule in `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/tools/scene_builder/layout_planner.py`:

- **`.tscn`:** `{major}.{minor}_{PascalCaseName}.tscn` (e.g. `1.2_Corridor.tscn`). Section `1.x` → folder `Arc_1`; `0.x` → `Main_Menu`; `8.x` → `Endings`.
- **Scene agent invariant:** targets must use these numbered names; simplified aliases (e.g. `Corridor.tscn`) must not be the pipeline output target.
- **`.gd`:** not required for every scene; when used, the corridor scene pairs script as `1.2_Corridor.gd` beside `1.2_Corridor.tscn` (`res://scenes/Arc_1/1.2_Corridor.gd`).

### Arc_1 — files found

- `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/scenes/Arc_1/1.1_SchoolExterior.tscn`
- `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/scenes/Arc_1/1.2_Corridor.tscn` (referenced by `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/scenes/Main_Menu/MainMenu.gd` and `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/test/scene_smoke_check.gd`)
- `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/scenes/Arc_1/1.2_Corridor.gd`
- `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/scenes/Arc_1/1.2_Corridor.gd.uid`
- **Non-canonical duplicate:** `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/scenes/Arc_1/Corridor.tscn` — still present; it attaches the same `1.2_Corridor.gd` but is the alias the canonical pipeline is explicitly told not to overwrite.

### Placeholders (Arc_1)

- **`1.1_SchoolExterior.tscn`:** contains a node named `1.1_EnvironmentPlaceholders` with Polygon2D children used as layout/geometry stand-ins (exact path: same file under `Arc_1` above).
- **`1.2` corridor:** no obvious “placeholder” keyword in the sampled `.tscn` headers; the redundant `Corridor.tscn` is best treated as a legacy alias alongside the canonical `1.2_Corridor.tscn`, not an official numbered placeholder from the builder map.

---

**Executive summary:** Under `scenes`, arcs live in `Arc_1`–`Arc_7`, with `Main_Menu` and `Endings` for `0.*` and `8.*`. Canonical scenes use `{major}.{minor}_{PascalCase}.tscn` inside the matching arc folder; Arc_1 currently has `1.1_SchoolExterior.tscn`, `1.2_Corridor.tscn` + `1.2_Corridor.gd`, plus legacy `Corridor.tscn`. Interior placeholder-style content appears explicitly under `1.1_EnvironmentPlaceholders` in `1.1_SchoolExterior.tscn`.
